entities.summary: Artamon Sergeyevich Matveyev was a Russian statesman, diplomat and reformer. He served as the head (dyak) of the foreign ministry from 1671 to 1676 during the reign of Alexis of Russia, succeeding Afanasy Ordin-Nashchokin.
